name: x400-address-constraint-rejected
description: permittedSubtrees with a single x400Address ([3]) entry on a critical NC extension. Validators that treat x400 as an unknown name-constraint form should fail-close.
notes: Raw DER: NC SEQUENCE { permittedSubtrees [0] { GeneralSubtree { base x400Address [3] { SEQUENCE {} } } } }. The cryptography library does not encode x400Address, so the extension is injected via unknown_extensions.
